name: NULL SIGNAL: SHELF FREQUENCY
description: A pirate broadcast collective running irregular transmissions on encrypted mesh nodes throughout the Shelf and lower Tier 2 districts, mixing investigative journalism, self-defense instruction, legal education (what corponation security can and cannot legally do in gray-zone districts), and testimony from residents who have experienced corponation overreach. Transmissions are never from the same node twice and range from 4 to 90 minutes. The collective has multiple anonymous contributors and no central editorial authority, which has made it resilient to infiltration.
cultural_impact: Its segment format — alternating hard testimony with practical survival information — became a template for pirate broadcasts across three other megacities, and its authentication codes are used as a trust signal in Shelf organizing.
story_hooks: A player is asked to physically carry a data package to a dead-drop location that will feed into the next transmission.
Someone is broadcasting false transmissions on the same mesh signature, and the collective needs help identifying the source before their network is burned.
A recent transmission contained information that could only have come from inside a corponation security briefing — someone is feeding the collective from the inside.
